package.author: David M. Anderson
package.description: Write ODT and DOCX from a docling DoclingDocument, in pure Rust

en-US.author: David M. Anderson
en-US.description: Write ODT and DOCX from a docling DoclingDocument, in pure Rust
en-US.name: waddle
en-US.releaseNotes:
- Keep a line break between two formatted runs on a second trip
- Write PDF superscripts, subscripts and table footnotes from docling.rs 2.80
- Bookmark every heading with its Pandoc identifier
- Refuse an office package given as input
- DOCX writes an SVG picture with a PNG in front of it
- Write anchors as bookmarks and #id links as internal links
